name: x-algorithm
description_en: Algorithm powering the For You feed on X
readme_excerpt: X For You Feed Algorithm This repository contains the core code that determines which posts a viewer sees in the For You feed on X. It combines in-network content (from accounts the viewer follows) with out-of-network content (discovered through ML-based retrieval and other mechanisms), filters content based on a variety of inputs, and ranks posts using a transformer model.
